join_order.notes: Bitset over partkey domain (max ~2M). Most selective filter applied first on lineitem scan.
Use orders_o_orderkey_lookup dense_pk_array for O(1) lookup. Check date inline after part filter passes.
Bitset over custkey domain (max ~1.5M). Check after order date passes.
Use supplier_s_suppkey_lookup for O(1) nationkey retrieval. Needed for BRAZIL check in CASE expression.

data_structures.part_qualifying_bitset: bitset(2000001) — set bits for partkeys matching p_type filter
data_structures.america_customer_bitset: bitset(1500001) — set bits for custkeys in AMERICA region
data_structures.america_nationkeys: flat_array(~5 int32) — nation keys belonging to AMERICA region
data_structures.brazil_nationkey: int32 — single value for BRAZIL nation
data_structures.orders_orderkey_index: mmap dense_pk_array — orders_o_orderkey_lookup.bin for O(1) orderkey→row_id
data_structures.customer_custkey_index: mmap dense_pk_array — customer_c_custkey_lookup.bin for O(1) custkey→row_id
data_structures.supplier_suppkey_index: mmap dense_pk_array — supplier_s_suppkey_lookup.bin for O(1) suppkey→row_id

dimension_setup.action: Scan 5 region rows, find r_regionkey where r_name='AMERICA'
Scan 25 nation rows. Collect n_nationkey where n_regionkey=AMERICA_regionkey into america_nationkeys set. Find n_nationkey where n_name='BRAZIL' → brazil_nationkey.
Scan c_nationkey column (1.5M rows). For each customer, if c_nationkey in america_nationkeys, set bit in america_customer_bitset at c_custkey.

Load p_type dict, find dictionary code for 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL'. Scan p_type column (2M rows). For matching rows, set bit in part_qualifying_bitset at p_partkey value (read from p_partkey column).

main_scan.mmap_advice: MADV_SEQUENTIAL on l_partkey; demand-paged on others (accessed sparsely after part filter)
filter_chain_per_row: 2. Lookup order_row = orders_orderkey_index[l_orderkey]. Check o_orderdate[order_row] in [9131,9861] → ~30% of 42K → ~12.6K rows
3. Get o_custkey[order_row]. Check america_customer_bitset[o_custkey] → ~20% of 12.6K → ~2.5K rows
4. Lookup supp_row = supplier_suppkey_index[l_suppkey]. Get s_nationkey[supp_row]. Check if == brazil_nationkey.

5. Compute volume = l_extendedprice[i] * (1.0 - l_discount[i]). Year = derive from o_orderdate[order_row] (year_idx = 0 or 1). Accumulate total_volume[year_idx] += volume. If brazil: brazil_volume[year_idx] += volume.

parallelism.partitioning: lineitem rows divided into morsels; each thread has local brazil_volume[2] and total_volume[2]; merge at end
parallelism.notes: Part bitset and customer bitset are read-only shared across threads. Index arrays are mmap read-only shared.

indexes.purpose: O(1) orderkey→row_id for date and custkey lookup

year_extraction.method: precompute epoch boundaries for 1995 and 1996 — if o_orderdate < 9496 (1996-01-01) then year_idx=0 else year_idx=1

pre_timer: dimension columns (region, nation, part, customer, supplier)
demand_paged: lineitem columns — MADV_SEQUENTIAL on l_partkey, no MAP_POPULATE on others
mmap_strategy.notes: Declare mmap resources before RAII timer scope to exclude munmap TLB shootdown cost
